title: Runner-authored stage artifact index
description: Normalized slot-zero index. Runtime additionally requires sorted unique names, contiguous slots, and exact equality with positional context pointers.

entries.description: Payloads ordered by semantic name. The index itself occupies result slot zero.

slot.description: One-based result slot; all slots must be unique and contiguous.

artifact.description: Runner-authored pointer, matching every field of the corresponding context pointer.
